_about: The FALLBACK estimate of XP remaining from Timeback alone, for a student this skill's store does not hold or when the store is stale; the store's mathAcademy.currentCourse.xpRemaining is the exact figure and is read first (ENABLEMENT example 3 step 1). The size of every course is Timeback's own course.metadata.metrics.totalXp, which the school sets from Math Academy's published XP-with-reviews figure per course. Read it LIVE from GET /ims/oneroster/rostering/v1p2/courses/{course.sourcedId}; this file carries the rules and points at the course ids, never a copy of the figure. remaining ~ course.metadata.metrics.totalXp x (1 - pct/100). These rules are the same as ENABLEMENT example 3; where the two ever differ, the example wins and this file is stale.
rules: 1. Seat: the student's current Math Academy enrollment(s): status active AND today inside beginDate..endDate. Do not use the primary flag (unreliable). If two seats are current, run the rules per seat and report both.

2. Percent: the newest Math Academy assessmentResult (filter student.sourcedId AND metadata.appName='Math Academy', sort scoreDate desc) that carries metadata.pctCompleteApp. Then GET that result's assessmentLineItem and compare its course.sourcedId with the seat's course.sourcedId. Equal -> pct = that percent, as of that scoreDate. Different -> the percent belongs to another course: NO estimate for this seat (basis 'none: newest percent belongs to <line item course.sourcedId>') and the seat is a finding (the student's events are being filed under a course other than the seat; DICTIONARY traps 10 and 21). The enrollment's own metadata.pctCompleteApp is a convenience only: use it when no percent-bearing result exists for the seat's course, and say so.
3. Size: GET the seat's course by sourcedId and read metadata.metrics.totalXp. remaining = totalXp x (1 - pct/100), basis 'timeback course XP'.

4. totalXp absent on the course (the bare 'Math Academy' course and the Beyond AI courses) -> no estimate (basis 'none: course has no totalXp'), and the enrollment is the finding: no real student belongs in those courses (owner rule 2026-09-17). Report a non-test student found there as a roster defect.

5. SAT Math Prep (use = never) -> no Timeback-only estimate (basis 'none: SAT Math Prep reports a score'): Math Academy reports an estimated SAT score there and progress is null; results filed under that course do carry pctCompleteApp values whose meaning is unknown (open question, ticket 22), so never compute from them. The store's xpRemaining IS served and exact on SAT Math Prep: report it.

6. No percent anywhere for the seat's course (no percent-bearing result, and no enrollment copy) -> no estimate yet (basis 'none: no percent yet'). The student may still have hundreds of results under other seats (DICTIONARY trap 3).

7. The course figure is expected to equal Math Academy's XP-with-reviews for that course (checked and matching for every course carrying a figure on 2026-09-17); if it lags a re-size the estimate reads low, and DICTIONARY trap 11 carries the measuring query.

8. Where this skill's store holds the student (ENABLEMENT example 10), its mathAcademy.currentCourse.xpRemaining is the exact figure as of figuresAsOf; it is the answer, and the estimate here is shown only as a labelled Timeback-only fallback.
bases: none: SAT Math Prep reports a score
accuracy_note: Poor, and the sign is not guaranteed. The current accuracy band is stated once, in DICTIONARY.md § Derived quantities (on 2026-09-17: 64 percent too high to 67 percent too low against the exact figure across about thirty students; usually low because Math Academy awards extra XP on failed reviews; wildly high near the end of a course). Never publish it as a number; 'a lot / a little / nearly done' at most. The exact figure is in the store.
courses_note: Course ids and titles are in reference/timeback-math-academy-courses.json; regenerate with GET .../courses/?filter=title~'Math Academy'.
retired: Until 2026-09-17 this file carried a per-course size calibrated against the Math Academy API. The owner ruled that Timeback's course totalXp is the figure to use and corrected the eight courses whose figure was low the same day; the calibration was removed so there is one basis, read live. Until 2026-09-17 evening rule 1 read the enrollment's percent with 'primary preferred'; a cold run showed that contradicts example 3 and mis-attributes a percent filed under another course, so rules 1 and 2 were rewritten.
